mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows and typically produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation is not significant (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 255.0, it signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 255.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200.0 (thousands of units), it signals a tight labor market and strong housing demand, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (UNRATE<3.5 AND HOUST>1200) fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle regime (CPIAUCSL>250 AND FEDFUNDS>3.0), the correlation between FEDFUNDS level and negative 20d returns is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03) over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceed 500000.0 (millions of dollars), it signals robust consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are supported by sustained consumption.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when RSAFS > 500000.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 (index 2017=100), it signals a weakening economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears accelerate market sell-offs.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200.0 and real personal consumption (RSAFS) exceeds 500000.0, it signals robust demand across housing and consumption, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy avoids a recession.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (HOUST>1200 AND RSAFS>500000) fails to produce positive 60d returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals a tight labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the economy grows without significant inflationary pressure.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between UNRATE level and 5-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation is not significant (t-test p>0.05).
